airport.definition: A place where airplanes take off, land, and passengers travel through.
airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.

balcony.definition: A platform that projects from the outside wall of a building, usually with a railing.
balcony.example: We stood on the balcony to watch the parade.

balloon.definition: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas, often used as a decoration.
balloon.example: The red balloon floated toward the ceiling.

branch.definition: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk.
branch.example: A bird built its nest on a branch.

brave.definition: Showing courage when facing danger or difficulty.
brave.example: The brave firefighter entered the building.

captain.definition: The person in charge of a team, ship, or aircraft.
captain.example: Our captain spoke to the team before the match.

cereal.definition: A breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk.
cereal.example: He poured cereal into a bowl.

church.definition: A building used for Christian worship.
church.example: The old church has a tall tower.

cinema.definition: A place where movies are shown to an audience.
cinema.example: We watched the new film at the cinema.

dentist.definition: A person trained to care for teeth and gums.

drawing.definition: A picture made with a pencil, pen, crayon, or similar tool.
drawing.example: Her drawing of a horse was very detailed.

earth.definition: The planet where humans and other known living things live.

engine.definition: A machine that produces power to make a vehicle or other machine move.
engine.example: The car engine made a strange noise.

forty.example: There are forty students in the hall.

fridge.definition: A refrigerator; a machine that keeps food and drinks cold.
fridge.example: The milk is in the fridge.

garage.definition: A building or part of a building where a car is kept.
garage.example: Dad parked the car in the garage.

guard.definition: A person who protects a place or people.
guard.example: A guard stood at the museum entrance.

half.definition: One of two equal parts of something.
half.example: She ate half of the sandwich.

idea.example: I have an idea for our class project.

island.definition: An area of land completely surrounded by water.
island.example: They spent their vacation on a small island.

lesson.definition: A period of time when someone teaches or learns something.
lesson.example: Today's science lesson was about plants.

magic.definition: The use of special powers or tricks that seem impossible.
magic.example: The magician performed a clever magic trick.

maybe.definition: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
maybe.example: Maybe we will go to the beach tomorrow.

monday.definition: The day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday.

month.definition: One of the twelve periods into which a year is divided.
month.example: January is the first month of the year.

museum.definition: A building where important, artistic, scientific, or historical objects are displayed.
museum.example: We saw dinosaur bones at the museum.

natural.definition: Existing in or produced by nature rather than made by people.
natural.example: This juice has a natural orange flavor.

north.example: We drove north toward the mountains.

october.definition: The tenth month of the year.
october.example: The festival takes place in October.

often.example: We often visit our grandparents on Sundays.

onion.definition: A round vegetable with layers and a strong smell and taste.
onion.example: She chopped an onion for the soup.

parent.example: Each parent received a copy of the school notice.

perhaps.example: Perhaps it will stop raining later.

picnic.definition: A meal eaten outdoors, usually during a trip or outing.
picnic.example: We had a picnic beside the river.

police.definition: The organization of officers who enforce laws and protect the public.

second.definition: Coming after the first in order.
second.example: She finished second in the race.

stomach.definition: The organ in the body where food begins to be digested after it is swallowed.
stomach.example: My stomach felt full after lunch.

study.definition: To spend time learning about a subject.
study.example: I need to study for tomorrow's test.

sunday.definition: The day of the week after Saturday and before Monday.
sunday.example: We usually visit family on Sunday.

sweater.definition: A warm knitted piece of clothing worn on the upper body.
sweater.example: She wore a sweater on the cool morning.

tablet.definition: A small flat computer with a touch screen.
tablet.example: He used a tablet to read the article.

ticket.definition: A printed or digital pass that allows entry or travel.
ticket.example: Keep your train ticket until the end of the trip.

tourist.definition: A person who travels to a place for pleasure.
tourist.example: The tourist took photos of the old buildings.

wallet.definition: A small case used to carry money and cards.
wallet.example: He keeps his bus card in his wallet.

warm.definition: Having a comfortably high temperature; not cold.

weekend.definition: Saturday and Sunday, or the period at the end of the working week.
weekend.example: We are going camping this weekend.

world.definition: Earth and all the people and places on it.
world.example: People around the world celebrate different traditions.

worry.definition: To feel nervous or concerned about something that may happen.
worry.example: Do not worry; we still have plenty of time.
